notes.title: December 18th [0.5.0.3] version update optimization announcement
notes.content:
Dear players:
We have optimized the game content in the new version "Ashes 2.0". The game update has been completed. Players need to exit the game client to update. If it is not automatically updated, please try to use the game integrity detection method to check whether the client version is the latest.

The contents of this update are as follows:

BUG fix
1. Fixed the abnormal scene problem of 2 blood moons appearing in the Qiaojia Lane plot
2. Fixed the props dropped by BOSS Qiao Xue, the spinning wheel formula and monster files will be dropped
3. Fixed the problem that the trees planted in the planting system cannot be collected
4. Fixed the abnormal triggering problem of scaring paper people in the medicine garden scene
5. Fixed the problem that the wedding party does not disappear after defeating BOSS Qiao Xue
6. Fixed the problem of incorrect menu names in Qiao's wedding banquet
7. Fixed the abnormal sound effect triggering problem of entering the stealing hole scene
8. Fixed the problem of shrubs or trees growing on the floor tiles built by players

Optimization and adjustment
1. Monsters in the wild of the level 3 area will refresh paper servants and paper maids
2. Monsters in the wild of the level 4 area will refresh short foxes
3. The number of ground wolves in the lumberyard area is appropriately reduced, and the number of refreshing paper servants and paper maids is increased
4. Banyan In the tree area, the number of mandrills is appropriately reduced, and the number of short foxes is increased.
5. The number of scarecrows is increased in the porter camp and field graveyard area.
6. The growth method and required growth stage of some crops in the planting system are optimized and adjusted.
7. The operation method of withering in the planting system is optimized and adjusted. Now 150 seconds can be obtained for watering.
8. Optimize and update the display of crop planting cycles.
9. Optimize the problem of physical collision after multiple players enter the teleportation array at the same time.
10. Adjust the rules of the construction of the teleportation array in the wild.
11. Adjust the name of the treasure chest built by the player, which has been changed to "small wooden box" and "big wooden box".
12. Adjust the property of the building base column. Now the base column no longer needs to be attached to the stone talisman.
13. Adjust the setting of the hanging lamp props. Now it can be made and repaired on the clothing table.
14. Optimize the material of the mining lamp and oil lamp of the art scene model

notes.title: October 28th "Charcoal Extinguished" v0.5.0.0 major version update announcement
notes.content:
Dear players and friends,

update and upgrade "Charcoal Extinguishing" to version 0.5.0.0 at 12:00 noon on October 28. In this update, we actively responded to the feedback from the majority of players, solved many bugs and gameplay difficulties in the game, and on the basis of retaining the storyline of Chinese folk elements, we have comprehensively optimized the exploration experience of the large world map . At the same time, it also includes many new features . We hope to welcome everyone to experience it with a brand new look.

[v0.5.0.0 version update content]

1、The demo version was released at the same time
We have separately produced a trial experience package with the same gameplay as the full game. In the trial package, you can experience the main storyline of "Qiao Family Clinic", "Safflower Field" and "Mysterious Winery". The estimated gaming experience time will be more than 3 hours.

2、New terrain and large world map
The new terrain and landforms are randomly generated by the program, with new mountains and rivers, which can better show the randomness of the terrain and the realism of the landform changes compared with previous versions. At the same time, new generation rules and program algorithms are used to avoid BUG problems caused by the fusion of different terrains.

3、Strengthen the new user guidance
A new guide task has been added at the beginning of the game to help you get started quickly. With the help and prompts based on the system, you can understand the gameplay more quickly.

4、Main story guide
The game has removed the design of collecting map fragments and exploring plot points on your own. Now, as the main storyline progresses, you can open the mini-map to view the next plot guide, simplifying the boring experience of excessive running around.

5、Planting system
Obtain plant seeds by collecting and gathering plants in the big world, plant them in specific planting racks for cultivation, and wait for the plants to grow before harvesting.

6、Game difficulty selection
We provide 2 different game modes for players to set and switch at any time.
1）[Story Mode] A mode designed for new players, story fans, architects, etc. who want a more casual experience
2）[Survival Mode] A game mode designed for players who want to challenge higher difficulty and feel the real pressure of survival.

7、New teleportation array system
In order to avoid boring and repetitive map-running experience, we have remade the teleportation array function in the game. The teleportation array drawings can be unlocked in the early plot, and the teleportation location can be freely set, which effectively reduces the time cost of players on the road in the big world.

8、Optimize drawing unlocking rules
Game prop production is the core module of SOC type games. In order to prevent players from missing out on key production props and being unable to continue the game, after this update, you can unlock the production drawings of the corresponding level by upgrading the workbench, without having to search for them yourself. (Some plot prop drawings will be unlocked in the main scene or after killing the BOSS)

9、Wild exploration and monster refresh
Compared with the wilderness and deserted village design in the previous version, after this update, players can experience about 36 different types of gameplay structures at once. Each scene will refresh various ghosts and monsters regularly, eliminating the trouble of not being able to find monsters.

10、New weather system
We have comprehensively improved the performance of the day and night visual effects in the game. Now you can more intuitively feel the difference between day and night in Yinxu. At the same time, we have also manually adjusted the lighting effects of each location to make the overall atmosphere of the game more contrasting.

11、Global action optimization
We are continuously optimizing the actions of characters and monsters to make their behaviors more natural.

12、Other content
1）Production facilities can be operated in batches. Stoves, wine barrels, silkworm beds, kilns and other production facilities now support batch production of props.
2）Clarify the area display in the world. Now you can more clearly get your own area location on the map and minimap.
3）Clarify the way to obtain props. Now you can get the acquisition information and drop location of the prop by checking the text description of the prop.
4）The casserole props required in the cooking process have been deleted, and now you can cook food directly.
5）Enhanced the folk feeling within the game.
6）Adjusted the submission props of the three braziers outside the ancient gate tower to make the game plot smoother.


[ FAQ for v0.5.0.0]

Q1When 	will the new version of "Charcoal Extinguished" be updated? Can I continue playing the game with the previous saves after the update?
The new version will be officially updated at 12:00 on October 28, 2024. Due to large-scale adjustments to the terrain, structure, and gameplay in the new version, the previous version archives cannot be used in the current version. If some players still want to use the previous archives to play the game, they can select the previous version in the game properties. For specific operation methods, please contact the QQ group administrator.

Q2 	Where can I download the game demo? Can the demo save file be used in the official version?
You can search for "Tank Extinguish" in Steam and enter the game store page to download the trial version of "Tank Extinguish" for free.
The trial version and the official version are two separate packages. Due to the rules of Steam cloud archive settings, the archives of the two cannot be shared and used with each other.

Q3What 	are the main updates in the new version? What bugs are fixed? What problems are solved?
For the main update content of the new version of "Charcoal Extinguished", please refer to the update content in this announcement. In addition to the main updates, we have also adjusted many detailed settings in the game, which can be experienced in the new version of the game.
Regarding the bugs fixed and the problems solved, we have solved three major issues:
1）	Make the game easier, reduce unnecessary exploration time during the map running process, and make the game more friendly.
2）	Clarify the goals of the game. Through the guidance of the new version, you can better establish the goals of the game, allowing players to quickly understand the gameplay and feel the core fun.
3）	Fixed blocking issues that occurred in previous versions, such as characters being stuck on incorrect terrain and some resources not being generated.

We have optimized the game experience.

Adjustment and optimization

2. Reduce the attack damage of monsters in the deserted fields and foggy fields
3. Add tips for obtaining some important props
4. Increase the continuity before and after the main storyline level. Now you can 100% get the map fragments of the next storyline and reduce the map exploration degree

18. Modify some area names that are easy to cause misunderstandings

2. Fixed the incorrect content of the key to open the red secret box
3. Fixed the judgment range of monster vomiting splash
4. Fixed the problem that some debuff effects were not cleared after death
5. Fixed the problem that non-host players could not gain proficiency when sneaking
6. Fixed the occasional incorrect performance problem after the outdoor stove was damaged
7. Fixed the problem of prompt error after the character was overweight and reborn

Bug repair

notes.title: 6月24日[v0.3.6.2]版本更新优化公告
notes.content:
亲爱的玩家您好：
在EA版本发布的首日，我们收到了许多热心玩家对于游戏的反馈意见，为此我们进行了一次基于游戏体验性上的优化。
目前更新已经完成，需要玩家退出游戏客户端完成更新后再登录游戏查看，若没有进行自动更新，请尝试使用检测游戏完整性的方式，查看客户端版本是否为最新。
本次更新内容如下：


调整优化
1.新增重要道具的来源信息描述
2.增强游戏界面按键提示
3.降低黑狗的攻击伤害
4.降低乔氏医馆关底BOSS乔肆的攻击伤害
5.剧情线索笔记本文本大幅优化 更明地给出下一步剧情的提示
6.更新地图残片道具 帮助玩家更方便寻找到剧情点
7.优化血月触发条件
8.删除所有种类工作台限制在独立房子内才可以升级的条件
9.增加野兔、鬼龙灯掉落油脂道具的几率
10.缩短丝线生产、酿酒工艺的产出时间
11.去除烤野味、烤禽肉、烤肋排在制作时烤糊的设定 去除烤糊后焦炭的产出
12.优化去掉体力不足的频繁飘字
13.优化工具台升级提示的UI说明
14.修复英文语言中物品弹窗详情的遮挡问题

BUG修复
1.游戏内所有不统一的名词（工具台、工作台等诸如此类）
2.修复被火焰烧死 重生后BUFF没有消失的问题
3.修复火把某些情况下没有正常燃烧的问题
4.修复某些情况下死亡葫芦无法打开的问题

性能优化
1.大幅优化在不同剧情区域来回移动时可能出现的频繁卡顿
2.优化怪物的行进路线 降低新地区的卡顿出现
3.优化开启多线程渲染，小幅度提高平均帧率
4.优化最大环境物可视范围50~80m 避免性能超过承载上限
5.优化资源加载/卸载时出现的卡顿

notes.content:
Dear players,

Currently, there is an issue in the game with incorrect crafting materials listed for the [Mugwort Sachet] blueprint. We have performed a temporary update to fix this issue. If the update does not occur automatically, please try verifying the integrity of the game files to ensure your client version is up to date.
